scenes.vo: Last night the elevator brought me back to my own door. Someone was knocking on it from inside.
Three slow knocks. Then silence. I checked my phone. It was three AM. Exactly.
Peepholes aren't made for looking in. But from the hallway side, the little glass was GLOWING.
Rule three said never look when the peephole is dark. It wasn't dark. So I pressed my eye against it.
I saw my boxes. My clock. My couch. And on the couch, someone was asleep in my grey HOODIE.
It had my hair. My face. It was ME. The me on the couch opened its eyes. They were RED.
